light: This is one ordinary frame pulled from a normal handheld video shot by a friend with a consumer camera at eye level, simply recording what happens, not composing a photo. The framing is casual and a little off: something is cut by the edge of the frame. Almost everything in the frame is in focus, nothing blurred out: the cluttered background stays fully readable. The only light is what the place really has, and each person and object gets light according to where it stands; correctly exposed, the side near the opening a little brighter and cooler, the far corners dimmer. Colours of an ordinary video with automatic white balance and almost no correction: moderate contrast, soft highlights, mild sensor noise and light compression, faint motion blur on anything moving. Skin with pores, small blemishes and uneven tone; hair with stray strands; clothes with real creases, dust and wear. People are caught mid-action, unposed.
look: Ordinary handheld home video filmed by a friend with a consumer camera at eye level, small natural shakes and casual slightly imperfect framing, everything in the room in focus, only the light the place really has, correctly exposed, automatic white balance, mild sensor noise; real skin and natural hands; people move naturally and unposed, nothing staged; no music.

clips.text: Buenos días. Traje testigo, porque si no, no me cree.
clips.action: he waves at the lens and points with his thumb at the neighbour. The neighbour (fourth reference image) stays where he is, listening, silent.

clips.line: Yo sigo diciendo que con leche no se pega nada.
clips.who: the neighbour, a stout man of about 65 with a thick grey moustache and a light-blue checked shirt (the fourth reference image)

clips.text: Yo sigo diciendo que con leche no se pega nada.
clips.action: The neighbour shrugs with his arms crossed, talking to the presenter with a sceptical smile; the presenter listens, silent.

clips.text: Primero la silla. Siéntate tú, que pesas más que yo.
clips.action: he takes the clamp off the chair and invites the neighbour to sit with an open hand. The neighbour (fourth reference image) stays where he is, listening, silent.

clips.line: A ver… Bueno, no se mueve.
clips.who: the neighbour, a stout man of about 65 with a thick grey moustache and a light-blue checked shirt (the fourth reference image)
clips.voice: in Spanish with a neutral Latin American accent, the gruff, amused voice of a 65-year-old man
clips.text: A ver… Bueno, no se mueve.

clips.text: Ahora la de verdad. Ata la cuerda a la punta, y colgamos la pesa.
clips.action: he ties the rope to the far end of the clamped board while the neighbour lifts the iron weight. The neighbour (fourth reference image) stays where he is, listening, silent.

clips.text: Ahí está colgando. Y ahora le sumo peso, de a poco.
Escucha la madera. Está sonando. Eso no es la cola, eso son las fibras de la madera.
clips.action: he bends toward the board with a hand behind his ear. The neighbour (fourth reference image) stays where he is, listening, silent.

clips.text: ¡Ahí está! Mira dónde se rompió. Al lado. La unión, entera.
clips.action: he picks up the broken piece from the floor and shows the break and the intact joint to the lens. The neighbour (fourth reference image) stays where he is, listening, silent.

clips.line: Bueno… me callo. Se rompió la madera, pero la cola no.
clips.who: the neighbour, a stout man of about 65 with a thick grey moustache and a light-blue checked shirt (the fourth reference image)

clips.text: Eso es lo honesto: la unión aguantó más que la madera. Lo mismo que hace una buena cola de ferretería.
clips.action: he takes the piece back and sets it on the bench, talking to the lens. The neighbour (fourth reference image) stays where he is, listening, silent.

clips.text: Y ahora sí, el error que te prometí. El que la hace fallar a las veinticuatro horas.
clips.action: he reaches under the bench and takes out a second glued board with a strip of blue tape on it. The neighbour (fourth reference image) stays where he is, listening, silent.
